chapter: Teddy Wilson bands and Cafe Society
title: How Hall met Teddy Wilson and what he was like as a leader
summary: Meeting Wilson through John Hammond's pick-up record dates, and a harmonious band without complications.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: What was Teddy like as a leader and, how had you met him? When he was with Benny Goodman?

I met Teddy when I was working at the Black Cat when John used to bring him down, so, I used to make those little small band recordings like Nan Wynn, and people like that, Harry Carney, little pick-up bands. This is how I met Teddy then. But at the same point when I did meet Teddy as the star performer, Roger Ramirez was also of that caliber.
I want go any further on that either.
Well, how was Teddy to work for in the big band. It must have been, from what you are telling
me it was a very harmonious situation because everybody was dedicated dancing.

Everybody was dedicated dancing. I couldn't think why anything, to answer your question how he was because we just did it. We did what we had to do. No complications other than trying to get a job. Then, after the big band, then we got the small band.
